title: Transport a finite flat morphism and its rank function
statement: Let T and U be commutative rings in universe zero, k : T ≃+* U, C a scheme in universe zero, and q : C → Spec U. Assume q is finite, flat, and locally of finite presentation. Put ε = Spec(k⁻¹) and qT = q ≫ Spec(k). Then qT is finite, flat, and locally of finite presentation, and for every point s of Spec T one has qT.finrank(s) = q.finrank(ε(s)).
lean_statement: ∀ (T U : Type) [CommRing T] [CommRing U] (k : T ≃+* U) (C : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{0}) (q : Quiver.Hom C (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of U))), AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite q → AlgebraicGeometry.Flat q → AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFinitePresentation q → let ε := AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k.symm.toRingHom); let qT := CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp q (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom k.toRingHom)); AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite qT ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.Flat qT ∧ AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFinitePresentation qT ∧ (∀ s : ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of T)), AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.finrank qT s = AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.finrank q (ε s))
